description: Value a business with a DCF: forecast cash flows, terminal value, discounting and a per-share estimate.
Test a retirement withdrawal rate against inflation and your horizon, and find the largest sustainable draw.
Apply the 4% rule and compare 3% to 5% withdrawal scenarios for income, longevity and ending balance.
Find the retirement corpus your income goal requires and the extra monthly saving needed to close the gap.
